name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home for rental purposes?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home for rental purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a rental tiny home varies significantly based on size, design complexity, materials chosen, and site preparation needs. Generally, costs can range from $75,000 to $200,000 or more. This estimate typically includes design, permitting, construction, and utility hookups. Factors like foundation type, interior finishes, and specific features for a rental market, such as durable surfaces, will influence the final budget. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a rental tiny home range from $75,000 to over $200,000, depending on size, design, materials, and site work. We provide detailed estimates after consultation.
